question: What Is the Difference Between Gas Group IIA, IIB and IIC?
body_html:
Gas groups IIA, IIB and IIC classify Group II flammable gases by how easily they ignite. IIC gases need the least ignition energy, so IIC equipment can also be used in IIA and IIB areas.

Gas groupIgnition energyExample gasesFlame path gap
IIAHigh, least sensitivePropane, acetone, ammoniaWide
IIBMediumEthylene, coke oven gasMedium
IICVery low, most sensitiveHydrogen, acetylene, carbon disulfideNarrowest
